Record notes

Ten complete methods for project structure, focused execution, plugin maintenance and accountable handoffs.

Version 0.2.0 includes 10 complete skill procedures. Complete methods, helpers and opt-in hooks; personal profile, goals and logs replaced by recipient templates.

Requirements: Host file and coding tools; Explicit receiving-host bindings for optional helpers.

License scope: MIT AND Apache-2.0 with retained upstream notices. Read the packaged notices and provenance before reuse.

Install with codex plugin add work-management@working-tools after adding JonathanKHobson/working-tools-plugins, or the documented Claude Code marketplace path. Installation and tested compatibility.

This ZIP has its portable manifest at the root, preserves all referenced package files. This release includes a separate per-file hash inventory. Built from 6ed6d74f97eac8279192dc9d954bae2a176b85fb. SHA-256: 125661190a544d8a69d0a0d321d7dc409627c1ded4f12d7c31bd388bd034125c.

Native marketplace distribution is separate from official OpenAI Plugin Directory publication. External provider access remains a prerequisite.
